Assesses practical iOS data modeling, SwiftUI wiring, and offline persistence with Core Data.

## Key Concepts
- SwiftUI MVVM data flow
- Core Data persistence
- @FetchRequest and predicates for filtering
- Debounced search with Combine/DispatchQueue
- Background vs main thread work and lifecycle handling
- Accessibility and basic testing

## Code Example
```swift
// Minimal Core Data save helper
func saveNote(context: NSManagedObjectContext, title: String, body: String, tag: String?) {
  let note = NoteEntity(context: context)
  note.id = UUID()
  note.title = title
  note.body = body
  note.tag = tag
  try? context.save()
}
```
